compiled_state.title: /dso:onboarding Strata awareness (detection + Socratic-confirmed posture + silent config + footguns)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Context

After a Strata project is scaffolded — by Epic A1's `create-dso-app.sh` or by manual `nava-platform`/`gem "strata"` adoption — `/dso:onboarding` is unaware of Strata. It writes generic `commands.*` keys that silently shadow Strata's Make targets (the friction the CI/CD audit flagged), misses well-documented Strata footguns (e.g., `ActionController::API` load-time crash, Case→Form FK violation), and never tells users about `nava-platform app update` as the canonical upgrade path. This epic adds Strata-awareness to the consolidated `/dso:onboarding` (per 136b-6758) via a sibling detector script, a `prompts/strata/` topic-prompt directory loaded surgically by phase mechanism, and ONE Socratic-confirmation dialog turn (non-tech UX = one yes/edit/no click). Detection feeds A0's namespaced array; config writes consume A1's shared `strata-config-defaults.conf` (drift prevention).

## In Scope

- New `plugins/dso/scripts/detect-strata.sh` (sibling to `detect-stack.sh`). Scans for `.template-*/<file>.yml` markers at PROJECT root (per A1's spike); reads `_src_path` to sub-classify (`framework:strata-rails` / `framework:strata-nextjs` / `framework:strata-flask` / `infra:strata`); reads `_commit` for upgrade-lifecycle context. Gemfile fallback uses canonical fingerprint `gem ['"]strata['"].*github:\s*['"]navapbc/strata-sdk-rails['"]` (NOT bare `gem "strata"`). Emits namespaced tags into A0's `stack` array per the v2 schema. Writes structured detection-facts artifact at `${WORKFLOW_PLUGIN_ARTIFACTS_DIR}/strata-detection.env` (KEY=VALUE: STRATA_TEMPLATE_KIND, STRATA_COMMIT_PIN, STRATA_SRC_PATH, STRATA_DETECTION_SOURCE in {marker, gemfile-fallback}). YAML field values written via `printf '%s=%q\n'` (bash-quoted) to prevent injection. `mkdir -p "$WORKFLOW_PLUGIN_ARTIFACTS_DIR"` before write. Multiline-aware Gemfile scan via awk (handles continuation patterns). Glob `**/.template-*/[a-z][a-z0-9-_]*.yml` supports monorepos. Reusable by Epic B's planning skills.
- New directory `plugins/dso/skills/onboarding/prompts/strata/`:
  - `README.md`: index documenting which sub-file the architect-foundation/dialogue phases load at which step; tags each sub-file silent vs. dialog
  - `config-writes.md` (silent): sources A1's `plugins/dso/scripts/lib/strata-config-defaults.conf` (ships in plugin filesystem); writes `commands.*` keys per detected `STRATA_TEMPLATE_KIND`. Multi-template projects: union per A0's multi-valued schema. Append via normalize-then-write helper (split on `;`, dedupe, rejoin) to prevent semicolon corruption
  - `arch-enforcement.md` (silent): appends Rails-Strata footguns from shared defaults to `.claude/ARCH_ENFORCEMENT.md` if `framework:strata-rails` is in stack array. Footgun idempotency keys on stable HTML-comment markers (e.g., `<!-- strata-footgun:rails:no-action-controller-api -->`), NOT raw rule text. Semantic overlap check before append: grep for keywords like `ActionController::API`, `belongs_to :case`; if found, emit `[A2 WARN] potential conflict: existing rule may overlap with Strata footgun '<title>'; review ARCH_ENFORCEMENT.md` and skip that footgun
  - `posture-dialog.md` (dialog): one Socratic turn presenting STRATA_DETECTION_SOURCE, detected template(s), `_commit` pin(s), `_src_path`(s), and the upgrade hint as the dialog's pre-filled default. Four responses: `yes` / `edit` / `not Strata` / `[I no longer use Strata]`. `not Strata` cleanup removes Strata tags from in-memory stack array; comment in project-understanding.md notes "User declined Strata configuration on YYYY-MM-DD". Non-interactive context (no TTY): default to `yes` (proceed with detected defaults) with audit log; documented in README.md. Strata-removal 4th response (`[I no longer use Strata]`) removes Posture section + footguns + Strata commands.* values
  - `posture-writer.md` (silent, runs after posture-dialog approval): atomic write via mktemp + mv -f. Writes approved `## Strata Posture` section to `project-understanding.md`. Idempotent (replaces existing section if present; otherwise appends)
- The relevant 136b-6758 phase files (architect-foundation, dialogue) gain phase-conditional Reads of these sub-files when `platform:strata` in stack array. Sequencing: config-writes during config emission step; arch-enforcement during enforcement scaffolding step; posture-dialog during dialogue/confirmation step; posture-writer after posture-dialog approval.
- `detect-strata.sh` wired into A0's detector-orchestration so its output unions into the unified `stack` array (NOT a separate config key). Documented in A0's `DETECTION-SCHEMA.md` as a worked example of "adding a sibling detector".
- New `--no-strata` flag for graceful skip on older plugin versions (when `prompts/strata/` subdirectory missing); explicit error if missing without flag: `[A2] requires prompts/strata/ from plugin v<min>+; update plugin or pass --no-strata`. Documented one-liner migration: `bash plugins/dso/scripts/detect-strata.sh && /dso:onboarding --resume=strata-only` re-runs detection + four sub-files without re-running other phases. STRATA_SKIP signal: `--no-strata` writes `strata.skip=true` to dso-config.conf; sprint/brainstorm/preplanning check this key for graceful degradation.
- Pre-commit hook `check-no-stack-case.sh` self-exclusion list covers the hook's own source, the synthetic-detector fixture, the schema doc's anti-pattern section.
- `dso:completion-verifier` validation on Strata-detected runs: (a) `commands.*` matches `strata-config-defaults.conf` for the detected variant, (b) all 5 Rails-Strata footguns present when `framework:strata-rails`, (c) `## Strata Posture` exists in `project-understanding.md`.
- Behavioral tests:
  - `tests/scripts/test-detect-strata-fixtures.sh` against 7 fixtures (rails-with-marker, nextjs-with-marker, flask-with-marker, infra-with-marker, manual-gemfile-only, no-strata, multi-template-rails-and-infra)
  - `tests/scripts/test-onboarding-strata-idempotency.sh` — fresh-from-A1 fixture: zero diffs in `commands.*`, `ARCH_ENFORCEMENT.md`, `## Strata Posture`
  - `tests/scripts/test-onboarding-strata-fresh-detection.sh` — manual-adoption fixture (Gemfile fingerprint match, no markers): asserts Gemfile-fallback fires, posture-dialog notes detection-source, post-`yes` writes land
  - Behavioral tests cover: not-Strata cleanup (asserts tags removed from stack array after dialog), non-interactive default (asserts dialog auto-yes when no TTY), version-skew error path (asserts clear error message + `--no-strata` skip works)

## Out of Scope

- Layer 4 microservice detection (Epic C — d08f-03d7-a148-43d0)
- Strata SDK planning context for brainstorm/preplanning/implementation-plan (Epic B)
- Sample-feature scaffolding
- NextJS/Flask-specific footguns (v1 Rails-only; SDK is Rails-only)
- Multi-template disambiguation dialog (A0's multi-valued `commands.*` handles natively)
- Mixed Strata-and-non-Strata polyglot (single-Strata-template-per-project for v1)
- Modifications to 136b-6758's phase mechanism — A2 consumes the mechanism as documented

## Success Criteria

1. Detection emits correct namespaced tags + facts artifact across 7 enumerated fixtures: (1) rails-with-marker (fresh A1 scaffold); (2) nextjs-with-marker; (3) flask-with-marker; (4) infra-only-with-marker; (5) manual-gemfile-only (Gemfile fingerprint match, no markers); (6) no-strata (negative case); (7) multi-template (Rails+infra). Each golden-master asserts emitted stack-array additions AND `strata-detection.env` contents. Malformed-marker case asserts non-zero exit + clear stderr naming the file.

2. Fresh-from-A1 idempotency: `/dso:onboarding` on A1-scaffolded project produces ZERO file diffs in `commands.*`, `ARCH_ENFORCEMENT.md`, `## Strata Posture`. Posture dialog presents detected facts; `yes` completes phase with no content changes. Confirmation receipt printed: "Strata detected — configured commands.* (test_runner=make test, lint=make lint-ci, ...), added 5 footguns to ARCH_ENFORCEMENT.md, wrote ## Strata Posture to project-understanding.md. No further Strata questions." Verified by behavioral test asserting (a) zero diffs (b) dialog-turn count = 1 (c) receipt content present.

3. Manual-adoption Gemfile-fallback: fixture with multiline-aware Gemfile fingerprint match and no markers triggers fallback. Two assertions: (a) `dso-config.conf` contains correct `commands.*` key-value pairs (unit assertion); (b) `validate.sh --ci` invokes the correct command string when run on the fixture (integration assertion).

4. Phase wiring + completion-verifier: `prompts/strata/README.md` documents sub-file/phase/step mapping; phase files Read sub-files at documented steps; `dso:completion-verifier` confirms (a) `commands.*` matches shared-defaults file, (b) all 5 footguns present (when Rails-Strata), (c) `## Strata Posture` exists. Behavioral tests cover not-Strata cleanup, non-interactive auto-yes, version-skew `--no-strata` skip, strata-removal 4th dialog response.

5. No Strata writes on non-Strata projects: `/dso:onboarding` on a non-Strata fixture produces zero `prompts/strata/*` Reads, zero Strata-specific writes, no Strata mention in any artifact.

6. Reviewer enforcement loop verified: A behavioral test submits a diff containing an `ActionController::API` subclass to a Strata-configured Rails project fixture; the code-reviewer agent returns at least one finding that references the ARCH_ENFORCEMENT.md footgun by keyword (e.g., contains `ActionController::API` or the footgun title). Test fails if findings list is empty OR if no finding references the footgun.

## Scenario Analysis

13 surviving scenarios from red/blue team filter (10 filtered). Mitigations folded into Robustness contract: silent-exit detection failures (explicit error + non-zero exit), ARTIFACTS_DIR creation (mkdir -p before write), multiline Gemfile (awk), not-Strata cleanup (tag removal from stack array), atomic writes (mktemp + mv), semicolon-corruption (normalize-then-write helper), monorepo (glob support), non-interactive default (auto-yes with audit log), KEY=VALUE injection (bash-quoted printf), posture-writer atomicity (mktemp + mv), version-skew (`--no-strata` flag + clear error), footgun text drift (HTML-comment markers as idempotency keys), footgun semantic overlap (warn rather than blind-append).

## Approach

Layered detection (sibling `detect-strata.sh` to existing `detect-stack.sh`, output unioned into A0's array) plus tiered prompt sub-files in `prompts/strata/` directory loaded surgically by phase mechanism. Single Socratic dialog turn for posture confirmation; rest is silent application. Sources A1's shared defaults file for drift prevention. Robustness mitigations across 13 surviving scenarios.

## Dependencies

All three blocking dependencies are in-flight epics in this same brainstorm session, not pre-existing infrastructure. A2 enters sprint only after all three are merged to main:

- A0 (188c-47e4-5abe-4b9c — namespaced array schema): `stack=` namespaced array; multi-valued `commands.*` semicolon-delimited; `DETECTION-SCHEMA.md` axis enum
- 136b-6758 (consolidated onboarding with prompts/<topic>.md mechanism): `phases/<phase>.md` orchestrators + `prompts/<topic>/` Read mechanism
- A1 (d765-a3b6-84bd-4816 — create-dso-app.sh rewrite): `plugins/dso/scripts/lib/strata-config-defaults.conf` (in-plugin filesystem, ALWAYS available regardless of host setup path)

Pre-sprint gate: `gh pr view <A0-pr> --json state` returns `MERGED` AND `gh pr view <A1-pr>` returns `MERGED` AND `gh pr view <136b-6758-pr>` returns `MERGED` BEFORE A2's first story enters sprint. Drift from specced contracts during implementation triggers `REPLAN_ESCALATE: brainstorm`.
